title: Persistent semantic state foundation v1

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User-approved 30-slice proposal with exact phase gates, boundaries, verification tiers, commit cadence, stop conditions, and deferrals.
Accepted persistent semantic state architecture direction and seven-loop horizon.

allowedWork: Exact stale-test expectation and generated-manifest repairs proven against canonical production owners.
One internal unit-scalar differentiable-map helper, only the market and circle caller migrations, and focused burden and inference measurement.
A narrow one-way adapter or shared formula boundary retaining exact-rational economics authority.

Internal semantic-state contracts, immutable storage, transactions, role bindings, change sets, recovery adapters, law tests, negative fixtures, diagnostics, architecture evidence, and project memory.
disallowedWork: No public semantic-state API, global store, event-sourcing framework, runtime Proxy, implicit assignment, or import-order registry.
No lazy derived evaluation, dependency cache, at-progress state families, interpolation, aggregate timeline, URL, Article, Focus Deck, renderer, Graph2D, KaTeX, CSS, or browser work.

No inferred derivatives, units, bases, equality, proof, physical predicates, price-floor parity, general CAS, theorem prover, ontology, HKT hierarchy, knowledge catalogue, procedure framework, broad macros, or LLM authoring.
No production behavior changes merely to satisfy stale ledgers, public facade expansion, broad directory rewrite, or unrelated worktree changes.
goal: Restore trustworthy project health, complete the bounded unit-scalar helper and exact-rational economics parity gates, then prove immutable entity/version identity, aggregate snapshots, explicit transaction operations, structural sharing, lineage, and direct recovery in one internal nonvisual kernel.
commitCadence: Commit implementation, tests, and completed Theseus evidence after each verified slice.
stopConditions: Stop if a ledger repair weakens a ceiling, deletes meaningful coverage, or changes product behavior solely to satisfy a stale test.
Stop if the helper must infer mathematical rules or weakens inference, diagnostics, identity, units, or law evidence beyond one bounded input-shape revision.
Stop if economics parity forks or replaces exact-rational authority or changes the approved supply-tax artifact.
Stop if identity derives from JavaScript reference, structural or glyph equality, renderer nodes, slot names, or transaction statement order.
Stop if committed snapshots mutate, branches leak, partial transactions escape, expired scopes remain usable, or recovery requires replay.
Stop if implementation requires a mutable global registry, import-order authority, public proxy, renderer/runtime dependency, or public facade expansion.
Stop if local inference cannot be bounded without weakening nominal distinctions or raising an unrelated global ceiling, or if any new broad failure appears.
Always stop after s30 at a mandatory human architecture and API checkpoint before loop 2.

slices.title: broad-failure-baseline
slices.summary: Captured and routed all 49 client failures: 16 catalogue/asset to s02, 14 generated order/direction to s03, and 19 renderer/source/architecture to s04; no behavior change or deferral required.

slices.title: catalogue-and-asset-ledgers
slices.summary: Reconciled all 16 catalogue and asset ledger failures to the canonical 60-asset registry, restored the saddle adapter in the test-only health registry, and verified generated manifests without production behavior changes.

slices.title: generated-order-and-direction-ledgers
slices.summary: Reconciled all 14 generated-order and direction failures, regenerated balanced-operation and 68-root reachability ledgers, preserved import-order determinism and an honest calculus promotion gap, and aligned human-readable direction with the approved state-foundation run.

slices.title: renderer-source-and-architecture-ledgers
slices.summary: Reconciled all 19 renderer, source-inventory, and architecture-ledger failures without production behavior changes; explicitly sealed hierarchical endpoint ownership into bounded compositor closure budgets, refreshed generated projections, and passed 64 focused tests plus dependency and type checks.

slices.title: repository-health-gate
slices.summary: Closed the pre-kernel repository health gate: reconciled downstream ledgers, passed 6080 tests, full TypeScript and Svelte checks, production bundle, and Theseus validation.

slices.title: helper-baseline-and-contract
slices.summary: Characterized the two unchanged pressure callers: their shared mechanics are isolated from authored affine and nonlinear rules, exact observable contracts are frozen, and focused authoring plus inference baselines are reproducible.

slices.title: unit-scalar-helper-core
slices.summary: Added the internal unit-scalar definition core: authored map and derivative magnitude rules remain explicit, while stable function, derivative, and unit-space identities follow the scoped context convention.

slices.title: runtime-guards-and-map-wrapping
slices.summary: Wrapped explicit unit-scalar definitions in the existing differentiable and pointwise linear-map contracts with three caller-named runtime unit guards and unchanged diagnostics.

slices.title: source-evidence-and-unit-latex-plumbing
slices.summary: Added the one-call internal authoring composition with explicit function and derivative provenance, named tested-law evidence, stable IDs, and derivative-unit LaTeX; no source, proof, unit relation, or presentation is inferred.

slices.title: market-migration
slices.summary: Migrated only the typed linear supply-demand caller to the helper, preserving exact public shape, shared space objects, IDs, values, derivatives, diagnostics, sources, law evidence, and scenario behavior; measured burden fell with bounded inference growth.

slices.title: circle-migration
slices.summary: Migrated only the nonlinear circle caller to the helper, preserving public shape, IDs, units, diagnostics, point-dependent derivatives, tested evidence, and the explicit signed vector-space extension; setup fell from 68 to 27 lines.

slices.title: helper-api-gate
slices.summary: Retained the internal one-call helper without revision: two distinct callers preserve mathematical visibility, exact diagnostics and identities, setup burden falls 48.6 percent, mechanical burden 56.3 percent, constructor burden 75 percent, and focused inference growth remains about 1.2/2.3 percent; all 6095 tests and broad gates pass.

slices.title: economics-parity-characterization
slices.summary: Characterized canonical exact-rational and typed pressure results for baseline and seller tax: equilibrium, buyer/seller incidence, welfare, units, and each model's distinct source identities now have exact expected evidence; neither implementation changed.

slices.title: exact-rational-adapter-or-formula-boundary
slices.summary: Added the narrow one-way projection from a canonical exact-rational supply-tax model into the typed pressure market; it normalizes exact inputs, rejects non-exact Number projection, validates all equilibrium and welfare outputs against canonical authority, and records explicit source/state links without reversing dependencies.

slices.title: parity-negatives-and-provenance
slices.summary: Closed parity negatives: canonical slope validation remains upstream, forged units and infeasible trade fail, non-binary-exact rationals are not coerced, explicit model/state IDs must close, a second market satisfies welfare laws, and price floors remain outside the adapter.

slices.title: economics-authority-gate
slices.summary: Closed economics authority with one canonical exact-rational source, a one-way typed adapter, explicit representability and endpoint gaps, reviewed-asset preservation checks, and a fully green repository gate.

slices.title: state-identity-contract
slices.summary: Defined deterministic scoped branded IDs for entities, immutable versions, aggregate snapshots, contextual slots, occurrences, aliases, labels, representations, transformation definitions, and applications; authors use factories rather than casts, and no runtime object identity or public facade is involved.

slices.title: immutable-entity-version-store
slices.summary: Added a persistent immutable entity/version store over structural semantic data: values are defensively cloned and deeply frozen, successors keep one entity identity with explicit transformation provenance, previous stores remain unchanged, and exact versions resolve from a committed index without replay.

slices.title: role-bindings-and-aggregate-snapshots
slices.summary: Added a complete immutable aggregate snapshot root that binds contextual slot IDs to exact entity/version references and materialized stores; aliases and labels remain outside snapshot identity, required slots cannot be omitted, and foreign or missing references fail locally.

slices.title: structural-sharing-and-branches
slices.summary: Added explicit successor snapshot construction with structural sharing for unchanged slots and stores, changed-node separation, branch isolation, and deterministic direct recovery. Corrected version and snapshot identity so branches derive from stable applied-transformation and revision keys rather than ordinal or statement order.

slices.title: pinned-references-and-recovery
slices.summary: Added nominal immutable snapshot, entity, and version handles plus a caller-owned materialized recovery index. Exact historical values recover without replay or current-state lookup, missing layers have typed diagnostics, and existing semantic-scene recovery behavior remains unchanged.

slices.title: change-dispositions-and-change-sets
slices.summary: Defined immutable persisted, revised, introduced, removed, copied, bound, and derived change records over exact pinned role endpoints. Validation enforces disposition-specific identity laws, snapshot closure, and unique target ownership without consulting payload or visual equality.

slices.title: explicit-transaction-lifecycle
slices.summary: Added an instance-local scoped transaction with deterministic successor identity, read-your-writes, failure-atomic staging, commit/abort, and capability expiry; no Proxy or global registry.

slices.title: update-operation
slices.summary: Implemented explicit update(previous => next): callbacks receive the pinned frozen value, yield same-entity successor versions with source and revision identity, advance every local alias, reject reentrant transaction effects and output nondeterminism, and leave no partial state on failure.

slices.title: shared-bind-operation
slices.summary: Implemented explicit shared binding: the target role adopts the source's exact entity/version without copying, later updates advance every alias in the scoped transaction, prior snapshots remain pinned, foreign capabilities and no-op binds fail, and snapshots reject conflicting active versions of one entity.

slices.title: copy-with-lineage-operation
slices.summary: Implemented bindCopy as a new materialized entity with cloned ordinal-zero value and exact copied-from entity/version, transformation, and authored-source provenance. Copies and sources diverge independently; reused, foreign, and cross-scope identities fail locally.

slices.title: introduce-and-remove-operations
slices.summary: Added total optional-role state: each optional slot is exactly bound or represented by a frozen typed absence. Introduce materializes a fresh entity from absence; remove preserves the old materialized store and records exact removed entity/version metadata. Required, absent, undeclared, reused, and ambiguous lifecycle operations fail locally.

slices.title: derived-binding-declaration-boundary
slices.summary: Added nominal serializable derived-slot declarations with stable slot dependencies. Aggregate snapshots treat them as read-only slot state, transaction reads and every write path return typed unsupported diagnostics, and successor snapshots share declarations without evaluation, caching, invalidation, or dynamic-read tracking.

slices.title: provenance-correspondence-and-law-convergence
slices.summary: Projected transaction commits into canonical semantic change sets, correspondence, entity registries, and lineage; rejects opaque or ambiguous staging; all focused and broad gates passed.
